title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Here’s what happened in crypto today
briefing: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
summary: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
briefing: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
summary: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
briefing: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
summary: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
briefing: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
summary: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
briefing: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
summary: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
briefing: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
summary: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
briefing: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
summary: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
briefing: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
summary: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
briefing: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
summary: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
briefing: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
summary: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
briefing: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
summary: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
briefing: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
summary: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
briefing: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
summary: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
briefing: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
summary: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
briefing: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
summary: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
briefing: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.
